title.narrative: Strengthening EA Science Diplomacy and Technical Strategies

description.narrative:
This WP intends to strengthen scientific cooperation across East Asia by connecting science and foreign policy to support regional stability and equitable growth. It addresses the need to expand the current draft regional science strategy beyond its trilateral (Japan, ROK, China) focus to fully include DPRK and Mongolia.
Key activities focus on low-cost digital methods, including conducting a desk-based audit of regional cooperation gaps and hosting virtual policy dialogues during scheduled network meetings. The primary deliverables consist of a sub-regional strategy alignment report and an operational analysis that identifies baseline standards and legislative gaps, highlighting how the lack of common regulations makes shared open science infrastructures difficult to operate across borders.
